description:
Brand Introduction

At Leauni, we celebrate the joy of reading through thoughtfully designed, high-quality products tailored for book lovers. From handcrafted leather embroidery magnetic bookmarks to innovative 3D pop-up bookmarks,etc, our creations are inspired by a passion for books and a commitment to artistry. Based on the foundation of uniqueness and personalization, Leauni aims to offer gifts that readers cherish and remember.

Product Description

  1. Leather Embroidery Magnetic Bookmarks

    • Crafted with premium leather and intricate embroidery.
    • Magnetic clasp for secure placement without damaging pages.
    • Customizable with initials, quotes, or designs for a personal touch.

  2. 3D Pop-Up Bookmarks

    • Creative, dimensional designs that make bookmarks a piece of art.
    • Lightweight and durable, perfect for daily use.
    • Available in a variety of themes to suit all preferences.

  3. Unique Designs

    • Many designs are exclusive to Leauni and cannot be found elsewhere.
    • Inspired by literature, nature, and art to resonate with readers of all genres.

Unique Selling Points (USP)

  • Exclusivity: Designs that are truly one-of-a-kind.
  • Quality Craftsmanship: High-quality materials and attention to detail ensure longevity and elegance.
  • Customization Options: Add a personal touch to make each product truly special.
  • Perfect Gifts: Ideal for book lovers, birthdays, holidays, and special occasions.

Affiliate Payment Terms

  • Commission Rates: Competitive rates starting at 10% per sale, with opportunities for higher percentages for top-performing affiliates. (Excludes shipping and taxes)
  • Payment Schedule: Payments are made monthly via [PayPal/Bank Transfer] once the minimum payout threshold of $100 is reached.
  • Tracking: Affiliates will have access to a user-friendly dashboard to track clicks, sales, and commissions in real time.

Additional Information

  • Promotional Support: Affiliates will receive high-quality images, banners, and pre-written content to help promote Leauni products effectively.
  • Exclusive Offers: Affiliates can share unique discount codes with their audiences, driving more conversions.
  • Performance Bonuses: Additional incentives for top-performing affiliates, such as increased commission rates or cash rewards.
  • Customer Base: Our target audience includes book lovers, gift buyers, and people seeking unique and customizable items.
  • Global Reach: We ship worldwide, ensuring that affiliates can reach a diverse audience.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up for the Leauni Affiliate Program through our dedicated affiliate portal 
  2. Gain access to promotional materials and your unique affiliate tracking link.
  3. Share Leauni products with your audience and start earning commissions for every successful referral.

We’re excited to partner with you in bringing the joy of Leauni products to readers and gift-givers worldwide! Let us know if you have any questions or need further details.
